title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Divya teams up with Prabhakaran and Vetri to trace Karna using a recorder. His conversation leaves them stunned as they learn he has murdered Parvathy over his desire for Swetha.

title: Pandian Stores 2
episodeTitle: Senthil Panics as Pandian Finds Theft
description: Raji and Meena confront Gomathi over reuniting Saravanan and Thangamayil. Meanwhile, Senthil panics when Pandian notices missing sales cash, fearing his theft will be exposed.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Cheran feels blessed to have Chandayatha, and Chozhan struggles to sleep. Meanwhile, Thenmozhi guards Nila's bathroom from Chandayatha's family until Nila stops her.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Meena and Shruthi care for pregnant Rohini, who thanks Ravi for his cooking. While discussing future plans, Muthu excitedly shares news of a new travels contract.

title: Super Singer Junior
description: Priyanka and Ma Ka Pa host the Top 10 Moon event. As guest stars join the fun, powerful singing acts impress the judges and lead to touching family moments.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Aadhavan deceives Karikalan to enjoy a beach outing with Pooja. Their playful race becomes tense when Karikalan unexpectedly arrives and interrupts their romantic moments.
